Pull model, no inbound ports

open on the plane until a box claims the work, runs it and
answers.

Refuse beats route
A refusing signal returns refuse and nothing runs. The session lane checks the daemon's socket and uid; when a check fails it never falls back to the console.

Fair, acked claims
A claim binds the task to box+slot. The box must report started within CLAIM_ACK_MS (20 s) or the task is requeued, up to 3 attempts.

Reset before the next claim
A slot that ran work is marked dirty and reset before it claims again. A failed reset keeps the mark and is retried with backoff.

The agent loop stays in the slot
The customer's Anthropic key arrives in a header on D1 and stays on the plane; the slot's agent calls the proxy with a run token only.
